domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the core architecture of AI Search. You will focus on how the platform processes information through NLP and NLU, and how indexing functions within the system to support search operations for the organization.

This domain addresses the configuration of search experiences. You will learn to manage search profiles, implement result improvement rules, and define facets to refine user search results for better information discovery across the entire platform.

This domain focuses on connecting external data to ServiceNow. You will study the setup process, different crawl types, and how to map users to external content sources to ensure data availability for all platform search users.

This domain covers advanced search features including hybrid search and RAG. You will learn about semantic search, vector embeddings, and the use of Genius Result Cards to enhance the search experience for all platform end users.

This domain covers specific enhancements introduced in the Zurich release. You will study dynamic windowing, multi-turn VA synthesis, and internationalization features to support global search requirements within the ServiceNow platform environment for all international stakeholders.

This domain focuses on maintaining search health and security. You will learn to monitor crawl history, manage connector roles, and enforce secure access policies to protect sensitive information during search operations within the ServiceNow platform environment.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam uses a linear format with multiple choice and multiple select questions. Manage your time effectively across the 15 questions provided. Ensure you have a stable connection and a quiet environment for the duration of the test to maintain your focus.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 15 questions. These questions are presented in a linear format and include both multiple choice and multiple select types to test your knowledge across the six domains covered in the official guide.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The exam uses a scaled score. The specific cut score is not publicly disclosed and is not always 70%. You should focus on mastering the exam objectives to ensure readiness for the assessment and overall platform proficiency.

The exam is included with ServiceNow University access. You should check with ServiceNow for the current pricing and access details regarding your specific account or organization to plan your certification journey and prepare for the 15 questions.
faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?

faq.answer_text: No, renewal is not required for this certification. Once you have passed the exam, your certification status remains current. For any future path requirements, check with ServiceNow for the current certification path and any updates to the 6 domains.

editorial.overview: The ServiceNow AI Search and External Content Connectors exam evaluates your professional proficiency in implementing and managing AI-driven search solutions. This assessment covers six distinct domains, including platform architecture, search configuration, external content integration, and hybrid search capabilities. It ensures you can effectively deploy and troubleshoot search features within the ServiceNow environment to improve user experience and information retrieval for all organizational stakeholders using the platform's advanced search tools. This evaluation confirms your ability to handle complex search configurations and data indexing requirements across the system.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official ServiceNow exam guide and documentation to understand the six domains. Focus on hands-on configuration of search profiles, facets, and external connectors. Practice mapping users and managing crawl history. Use the ServiceNow Community resources to clarify concepts like vector embeddings and semantic search. Ensure you are familiar with the specific Zurich enhancements and security roles required for secure access enforcement. Consistent practice with these tools is required for success, as the exam tests your ability to apply these configurations in real-world scenarios.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is intended for platform administrators and developers who configure AI Search and integrate external content sources. You should have practical experience with ServiceNow search architecture, NLP, and connector setup to successfully manage search profiles and result improvement rules.
